revisions.summary: I picked up the upper voice just before the two low beats. The short drum fills now interrupt both middle bursts, and the bare words leading back to the drums are lighter. (The opening vowel at 0.13 s could not be kept: a ride cannot land that early. Two faint notes less than a tenth of a second from a landing were folded into it.)

points.text: The bright syllable and the two low answers each get a landing.
The little drum lands inside the burst. It returns at 24.52.
The quiet renewals lead into a shared drum and word.

revisions.summary: Nothing changed in the reading: it is the one approved before the blend took its place as the main reading.

The intention: Let the rider rock along with the opening words and lean forward on the two low beats. Give the paired syllables one easy, loping stride. Twice the little drum fill pulls him sharply down and through, and twice he settles back into that stride. The shared word and drum near 29 seconds sets a heavier tread that lasts until the voice lets go and the upper reply lifts clear of the ground.

The intention: Give the mapped words a gentle sway, leaning into the ends of the phrases and pulling back after the low double stroke. Across the middle, the first sung stroke carries the long bow and the second stays close beneath it. The bows grow through the centre and dissolve into the exposed words, where even the low beat leaves space for the reply. The drums widen the stride in two waves. The last words settle, then the upper answer gets one more rise.

The intention: Slowed, the centre of the song is a swing. Each measure has two long breaths, and the rider uses them: a high, round arc into every strong syllable, then quick low steps through the answer and its small neighbours, so the measure reads as loft, step, step, again and again. The sung opening, mapped by hand, stays as it was, carried low and unhurried; the two low strokes at 7.9 cut it off hard. The exposed link floats, and after 28.9 the broken drums keep a smaller version of the swing: a shorter lift into each bar's heavy head, flat and fast between. The approved reading rode at an even height with the strong and answering syllables close in weight; here the long gaps become height and the answers step back. Most visible from 12.3 to 26.8 s.

The intention: Slowed, the centre of the song is a swing, and the rest is the approved ride he loved. The two sung sentences at the start and their two low strokes are the approved reading. In the centre each measure has two long breaths, and the rider uses them as Opus did: a high, round arc into every strong syllable, then quick low steps through the answer and its small neighbours, the strokes in three clear weights. The exposed words float (Opus) before the shared word and drum at 28.9; the broken drums keep the approved even run and strengths, which held their heavy bar heads best of the four. My own part: the swing's last echo, one rise as the upper reply lifts clear at the very end.
This is the blend, the main reading of the song since 2026-11-19. Nothing changed in it.
